text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy manages an<n>impressive performance
that exceeds<n>expectations. However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph... How was that?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it wasn't too bad. A bit<n>boring when
she doesn't bite anyone<n>though. What happened to
her<n>comedy act?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm so relieved that nobody<n>got bitten... If
she pulled that kind of<n>thing during the race, it could
have led<n>to a big accident.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I was really hoping that race would be<n>a rare
spectacle, but she just ran like<n>normal... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, I'm gonna head back to the<n>waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're coming too!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, is Windy already leaving?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
But her running was so amazing. I<n>really wanted to
shower her with<n>more cheers and applause...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glancing over at the source of that<n>last comment, I
see a woman<n>clutching a Shinko Windy plushie
close to her chest.
choice_data_list: (So Windy does have some fans out there...)

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
I don't think you're a comedy act at<n>all, Windy...
You were incredible...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Gee... Seems everyone's really<n>pinned Windy as
some kind of clown,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's like nobody actually cares how<n>she runs—they
just love seeing her<n>cause havoc...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair... Windy is a really<n>great racer who
puts care into herself<n>and her form!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And she's improved so much since<n>the last time I
saw her...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She's full of drive! When she says<n>she wants to
win and show off her<n>skills, she really means it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And she pulled it off today, even<n>among such an
unpleasant crowd.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Meanwhile here I am, on the verge<n>of giving up.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Those people said so many mean<n>things to her...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How is she able to keep pushing on?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew... I managed to hold myself<n>back again today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh, I know that. You don't gotta<n>spell it out.
choice_data_list: Didn't you feel like waving to the crowd?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nah, it wasn't important.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That kinda thing can wait until I've<n>achieved my
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a fierce determination in her<n>eyes. It seems
she's set on<n>redeeming herself first.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nobody sees my strength right now,<n>so if I try to
interact with the crowd,<n>they'll just make fun of
me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But! One day, it's gonna be different.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I just gotta stay patient until then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Patience... If she's willing to be<n>patient, then instead
of rushing for a<n>big win in a G1 race, it might be
better<n>for us to choose a race that'll let her
showcase her skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can focus on training for the time<n>being, and
then take on bigger races<n>once the new year
begins. In which<n>case, our next race shouldn't be a
G1.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Decided, have ya? C'mon, spit it<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hrrm, the Tokai Stakes, huh? I hear<n>there's a
bunch of tasty food in Aichi.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. I trust that my diabolical<n>strategist has
some sort of plan in the<n>works.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All I gotta do is knock it outta the<n>park!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she displayed some fine<n>running
today, it's hardly done<n>anything to better her
reputation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, she continues to rise to<n>the challenge.
For now, we decide to<n>return to summer camp.
